note: 30 reworded questions written by a coding agent, one per agent, for the find_agents embedding test. No content word of a question equals a word of its agent's name. Agents are ones the 23 older paraphrase items do not use. Split fixed by position before any scoring: i % 5 < 2 is dev. Frozen before the first hybrid run; questions are never edited after results (drop and disclose instead).
